classification.difficultyReason: Development: compare four displays for truncated baselines, unequal bar widths and perspective, then select the faithful representation. The taught baseline checks must be combined with the broader instruction that misleading features are not exhaustive.

content.prompt:
A survey was conducted where people were asked which of two brands of smartphones they preferred. The results were:
48% preferred Brand X
52% preferred Brand Y
A graph displaying the data is to be included in a magazine article. The editor of the magazine wishes to ensure that the graph is not misleading in any way. Which graph should the editor choose to include in the article?

spec.description: (A) Survey Results. Percentage of responses versus Brand X,Brand Y. 2D equal-width bars at48 and52; vertical46–58 by2, truncated baseline.
spec.answerVisibility: question; assessed misleading features intentionally retained

spec.description: (B) Survey Results. Percentage of responses versus Brand X,Brand Y. 2D bars at48 and52; vertical0–60 by10; X visibly narrower than Y.
spec.answerVisibility: question; assessed misleading features intentionally retained

spec.description: (C) Survey Results. Percentage of responses versus Brand X,Brand Y. 3D bars front heights48 and52; vertical46–58 by2; truncated scale and perspective.
spec.answerVisibility: question; assessed misleading features intentionally retained

spec.description: (D) Survey Results. Percentage of responses versus Brand X,Brand Y. 2D equal-width bars48 and52; vertical0–60 by10.

answer.short: D. It has a zero baseline, a consistent scale and equal-width bars.
answer.worked: A has a truncated scale. B has unequal bar widths. C has a truncated scale and 3D perspective. D uses a zero baseline, equal bar widths and a consistent scale. Correct answer: D.
